meta.name: PD Analog Memories
meta.author: PLUIT / diva-mcp
meta.description: Warm, slightly unstable analogue pad: two gently detuned saws, slow swell, soft cascade filter and drifting pitch.
meta.usage: Velocity: level and a touch of filter opening. Hold chords.

concept.intent: A warm analogue pad that feels like a half-remembered tape recording: soft edges, gentle beating, never perfectly still.
concept.spectral: Two saw waves (Dual VCO) detuned by ~8 cents for slow beating; HPF Pre trims sub mud.
concept.temporal: Slow amp attack (48) and long release (58); filter envelope slower than amp so brightness blooms late.
concept.filtering: Cascade (smooth 4-pole, clean) at a muted cutoff (74), low resonance, moderate key follow.
concept.modulation: Env2 opens the filter slightly; slow LFO2 (random restart) breathes the cutoff; LFO1 random-glide feeds a small vibrato for tape-like wander.
concept.space: Classic chorus for width, then a darkish plate.
concept.architecture: Dual VCO + Cascade: the Jupiter-style VCO pair is the natural pad source, Cascade stays smooth with dense input.

meta.name: BS Deep Current
meta.author: PLUIT / diva-mcp
meta.description: Dense, musical mono bass: three VCOs with a sub-octave, round ladder filter with a punchy envelope.

concept.intent: A deep, round bass that carries a track: solid fundamental, articulate attack, no fizz.
concept.spectral: Triple VCO: saw-ish osc1, slightly detuned square-ish osc2 for body, triangle-ish osc3 one octave down as sub; mixer feedback adds low-end weight.
concept.temporal: Instant attack, medium decay to a solid sustain, short release.
concept.filtering: Ladder 24 dB at a dark cutoff (52) with moderate resonance; Env2 snaps it open on each note.
concept.modulation: Env2 -> cutoff (48), mod wheel -> cutoff (30) for performance.
concept.dynamics: Velocity scales the filter envelope more than the amp.
concept.architecture: Triple VCO + Ladder: the classic Minimoog-style bass pairing.

meta.name: KY Faded Piano
meta.author: PLUIT / diva-mcp
meta.description: Soft electronic keys: hollow DCO pulse through a muted multimode filter, gentle chorus and a small plate.
meta.usage: Velocity = brightness. Chords and slow melodies.

concept.intent: Faded electric-piano-like keys: struck, warm, a little worn, sitting behind a vocal.
concept.spectral: DCO PW-reactive pulse at 30% width (hollow), saw off, a quiet sub and a hint of noise for 'air'; HPF Pre removes boom.
concept.temporal: Instant attack, medium decay to low sustain — a struck, decaying envelope. Digital envelope with curve (C) for a softer shape.
concept.filtering: Multimode LP4, cutoff 70, light resonance, strong key follow so high notes stay present.
concept.modulation: Env2 -> cutoff, velocity -> cutoff, slow LFO2 PWM for movement, random per-note pan for width.
concept.dynamics: Velocity on both envelopes and the cutoff.
concept.space: Classic chorus (Juno-like pairing) then a short dark plate.
concept.architecture: DCO + Multimode: the Juno-style signal path is ideal for polished, chorused keys.

meta.name: PL Distant Echo
meta.author: PLUIT / diva-mcp
meta.description: Melancholic pluck: digital triangle with an octave saw, silky Uhbie filter snap and a wobbling tape-style delay.

concept.intent: A short, bittersweet pluck whose echoes drift away like a memory.
concept.spectral: Digital oscillator: triangle (with its synced sine harmonic) as the core, a quiet sawtooth an octave up for a glassy edge.
concept.temporal: Instant attack, short decay, no sustain; filter envelope even shorter than the amp for the pluck.
concept.filtering: Uhbie 2-pole SVF mostly low-pass (mix 8), cutoff 62, moderate resonance — silky rather than aggressive.
concept.space: Delay 3/16 - 4/16 - 6/16 with damped feedback and wow (tape wobble), then a large soft plate.
concept.architecture: Digital + Uhbie: a cleaner, slightly glassy source contrasts with the analogue presets and the SEM-style filter keeps it smooth.

meta.name: LD Northern Light
meta.author: PLUIT / diva-mcp
meta.description: Expressive analogue mono lead: three VCOs into a Bite Rev 2 filter, legato glide, mod-wheel vibrato and aftertouch brightness.
meta.usage: MW = vibrato (fades in), AT = brighter, legato = glide.

concept.intent: A singing lead with a bit of bite that responds to the player: vibrato on the wheel, brightness on pressure.
concept.spectral: Triple VCO: saw osc1, detuned narrow-square osc2, a quiet triangle-ish osc3 an octave up; a little mixer feedback.
concept.temporal: Near-instant attack, high sustain, medium release; legato with glide.
concept.filtering: Bite (MS-20-style) Rev 2, cutoff 78, resonance 32 — characterful but not screaming at these levels.
concept.modulation: Env2 -> cutoff (26), Pressure -> cutoff (24); LFO1 vibrato with depth controlled by the mod wheel and a delayed fade-in.
concept.dynamics: Velocity on both envelopes, aftertouch for brightness.
concept.space: Rhythmic delay (3/16, 6/16, 4/16) into a medium plate.
concept.architecture: Triple VCO + Bite: fat Minimoog-style source with the more aggressive, vocal Bite filter for an expressive lead.
